values.heading: Before you book
values.intro: The things clients ask us most often. If yours is not here, just ask.

faqs.question: How much does a first visit cost?
faqs.answer: The first visit is free. We walk the garden with you, take notes and send a written quote within three working days.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer:
We work across:

  • Bristol and South Gloucestershire
  • Bath and North East Somerset
  • North Somerset, as far as Clevedon

faqs.question: Do you use peat or chemical weedkillers?
faqs.answer: No. We use peat-free compost and hand-weed or mulch instead.
